This is one of if not the most frustrating horror game I have ever played. To begin with, the entire experience is timed. You only have so much time to complete mundane house cleaning tasks such as cleaning toilets and dishes and picking up trash or the level or night ends in failure. And not IF but WHEN the monster catches you, you will have to start the entire level or night over. Numerous times, I almost completed the final task only to be caught and start all over. Batteries also run out within seconds and I experienced a bug where the flashlight would not reload even though I had batteries in my inventory. The difficulty in this game gets more and more excessive with each night. By night two, there are fewer batteries available and almost all doors are locked with padlocks that cannot be unlocked with the combination provided in the note where you start. I didn't even make it to night three before giving up in frustration. The developer has also mentioned in the Steam discussions that nights 3-5 are extremely difficult. Other issues I encountered are glitching textures in the garage, random frame rate drops no matter what graphic setting, no way to manually save, cannot change the fov, and cannot remap the mouse keys. The monster also seems to glitch red and can kill you through walls that ends in a cheap still image of the monster's face. It's obvious that the developer made up for a lack of content by increasing the difficulty so that levels or nights will have to repeated over and over again. For me personally, this is not my idea of fun and I would rather spend my time playing better games.
